profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at GE Aerospace
profile.summary:
I am currently employed at GE Aerospace as a member of the Edison Engineering Development Program.

Main professional interests include Software Development, Engineering, and Testing.

positions.title: Edison Engineering Development Program
positions.description: Edison Engineering Development Program (EEDP) is a globally diverse program with 3-4 rotations for those with a passion for technology and a drive for technical excellence.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Host and conduct weekly labs involving 50+ students. 
- Host and conduct weekly help rooms open to 500+ students.
- Assist in the learning and teaching of students from various backgrounds and majors of study.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Teamwork · Team Leadership · Teacher Training

positions.title: Aerospace Systems Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Implemented updates and fixes for an embedded web application located on a Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) switch.
- Developed new test cases for an embedded systems acceptance test procedure using NI TestStand and LabWindows/CVI.
- Created automated bid sheet integration tools using Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) .
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Web Development · NI TestStand · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · LabWindows/CVI

positions.title: President
positions.description:
- To work act as Chief Chapter Officer and overview the local chapter.
- To work with internal teams and ensure the success of New Members, Philanthropy, Recruitment, and Programming.
- To develop and execute plans.
- To appoint committees and officers.
- To act as a chapter delegate for national fraternity conferences.
- To take on any and all leadership and chapter management tasks.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Performed Manual/Automation testing of head units and infotainment systems.
- Developed a GUI which automated the API testing process of head units using Python and .bat scripting.
- Participated in complete Software Testing Life Cycle and Defect Life Cycle.
- Participated in Sanity, Stability, Smoke, and various forms of testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Manual Testing · Test Automation · Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)

honors.title: Bryan Scholars Scholarship
honors.description:
The Bryan Scholars program was founded in 2021 by Robert Bryan (Sigma Rho ’57) & his wife Julie.

The purpose is to help 5 young Dekes each year with tuition and fees at the undergraduate or graduate level. All applicants must be in good academic standing with their institutions and be full-time members, in good standing, of Delta Kappa Epsilon.

Selection criteria: academic achievement; service to their DKE chapter; leadership skills and accomplishments; goals for the future; and service to their college or university.

honors.title: Dean’s List
honors.description: The Dean's List honors all full-time undergraduates in the University who earn a 3.50 or better grade-point average for the courses totaling 12 or more credits for a given semester
